title: Egypt History Tracker Update — May 09, 2026
summary: The Grand Egyptian Museum opened fully to the public on April 26, 2026, marking a cultural milestone as the world's largest single-civilization museum welcomed visitors at Giza for the first time at full capacity — driving a 43% surge in Q1 tourism to a record $5.1 billion. President Sisi deepened Egypt's geopolitical footprint by deploying Rafale jets to the UAE in solidarity amid the Iran-Israel-Gulf conflict, while investigative reporting confirmed Egyptian officers were killed fighting alongside Sudan's military — Egypt's first acknowledged combat casualties in that conflict. Economic indicators continue improving with inflation falling to ~13.8% (from a 40% peak in 2023), net reserves reaching $53 billion, and the IMF completing its fifth and sixth EFF reviews with a $2.27 billion disbursement. Two new contested claims were added covering the GERD Nile water dispute and Egypt's Sudan war role.
